Name: overflow Redirect
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
⛏️ Mine Overflow Storage
📦 Never leave valuable mining loot behind again!
[b]Mine Overflow Storage[/b] automatically sends eligible mining resources to your designated chest when your inventory is full.
Just choose a chest, press [b]F8[/b], and keep mining. Simple, lightweight, and hassle-free.
[line]
[heading]⚙️ How It Works[/heading]
[b]1️⃣ Choose your chest[/b]
Open any chest you want to use for overflow storage.
[b]2️⃣ Press F8[/b]
While the chest is open, press [b]F8[/b] to designate it as your Mine Overflow Chest.
[b]3️⃣ Keep mining[/b]
When your inventory becomes completely full, eligible mined resources are automatically sent to your selected chest.
[b]4️⃣ Keep going![/b]
No need to constantly return to the surface just because your backpack is full.
[line]
[heading]✨ Features[/heading]
🔹 [b]Automatic Overflow Storage[/b]
Mined resources go directly to your selected chest when your inventory is full.
🔹 [b]Simple Chest Selection[/b]
Open a chest and press [b]F8[/b] — that's it.
🔹 [b]Easy to Change[/b]
Want a different chest? Open it and press [b]F8[/b] again.
🔹 [b]GMCM Support[/b]
View and manage your selected chest through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].
🔹 [b]Safe Storage[/b]
If your selected chest is full, missing, or unavailable, the mod won't delete your items.
🔹 [b]Vanilla-Friendly[/b]
When your inventory has space, everything works normally.
🔹 [b]Lightweight[/b]
Designed to do one thing without adding unnecessary systems or complicated menus.
[line]
[heading]📥 Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/*]
[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]. [/*]
[*]Extract
[code]MineOverflowStorage[/code]into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder. [/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Open your preferred chest and press [b]F8[/b]. [/*]
[/list]That's it!
[line]
[heading]📋 Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] [/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] [/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] [/*]
[/list]No additional frameworks are required.
[line]
⛏️ Mine More. Carry Less. 📦

Manifest.Name: Overflow Redirect
Manifest.Description: When your inventory is full, automatically redirects any item into your designated overflow chest(s). Press F8 while a chest is open to add it to the overflow list. Press F8 again to remove it. Supports multiple chests.
